$comment: Registry of the cua SDK e2e scenarios (plan §3.5). run.py reads it to build the guide x language x lane matrix; every test records {scenario, lang, lane, status, secs, reason} into $CUA_E2E_RESULTS/<lang>.jsonl. `lanes` lists where a scenario is expected to run; a cell absent from the results is reported as `missing` and fails --strict. `only` narrows the languages expected in a lane.

hermetic.what: loopback fixtures: MockServer spacesd + fake Fleet API (cua-test-fixtures), cua daemon from the CLI

container.what: Docker engine, gVisor (runsc) when present; reference images linux and plain/*

qemu.what: local QEMU (hvf/kvm) booting the reference containerDisk disk; <=1 VM, <=4 GiB

lume.what: lume serve (macOS hosts) booting the arm64 reference disk; <=1 VM, <=4 GiB

fleet.what: live Fleet (run.cua.ai) with the public legacy image; pools cua-e2e-<run>-*

fleet-env.gate: CUA_E2E_FLEET=1 + CUA_E2E_FLEET_ENV_IMAGE=<amd64 linux ref Fleet can pull>
fleet-env.what: live Fleet with the spacesd reference image

cua-sandbox.what: cua-sandbox public API (the wrapper over the cua SDK); runs after the wrapper merge

docs.what: hermetic docs code blocks (test="docs"), extracted by docs/extract.py; runs with the hermetic lane

contrib.gate: CUA_CONTRIB_FIXTURES=<cua-contrib-fixtures binary> + a cua binding built with --features contrib
contrib.what: contrib providers against schema mocks of their APIs (cua-contrib-fixtures): the contrib docs blocks and a cua-bench task on --on daytona

scenarios.checks: apply pool -> claim -> uname -a -> screenshot PNG -> delete (fleet lane: legacy /cmd through the `server` service)

warm pool (replicas=1), wait ready, named claim reattaches, scale replicas, ephemeral sandbox claims from a managed cua-auto-* pool, which the test GCs; name collision (CUA_E2E_FLEET_TAKEN_POOL) is a typed error
@trycua/cua/browser (wasm): env over gRPC-Web in Node; in headless Chromium (Playwright) also Fleet claim/list/release through a same-origin proxy (the wasm Fleet transport needs a window)
pool TTL lands in the pool spec, claim TTL lands in the claim lifecycle; cua-sandbox: spec + ttl -> ValueError
smoke: build the mirror's native Fleet SDK, run the provider's unit tests; TF_ACC=1 adds its envtest acceptance test
spacesd desktop: dimensions, screenshot, clipboard round trip, click + keypress land in the grid/form fixtures, /mcp initialize on the env port
cua-spacesd viewer on the `env` service (3211): GET /viewer/ through service + forward, viewer_url mints a ticketed link
`cua image build` (layers) -> push to a registry -> boot the pushed ref locally -> layer effects visible; Fleet: Image.from_registry (ts/rust exercise the same builder through the SDK in `images`)
local layers (run/env/copy) apply; Fleet: remote build via create_image or a clear typed error
spacesd in Docker, connect_url(url, token), conformance smoke; rust also runs the spacesd conformance suite (CUA_E2E_CONFORMANCE=1)
same script embedded and through `cua daemon` gives identical results; two processes share one daemon-held sandbox
reference image as a local container sandbox (gVisor) -> env smoke; rust: fork + checkpoint through cua-vmm
reference disk under QEMU -> readiness probes + forward (py/ts); rust: env smoke with a cloud-init token, checkpoint, fork, boot the fork
reference arm64 disk under Lume -> env smoke -> checkpoint -> fork
plain images with no cua daemon: lifecycle, ports/forward, tcp/http readiness probes; env() raises SpacesdNotAvailable

every docs block tagged test=docs|container|fleet|terraform runs in that lane (Python in a venv, TypeScript through tsx; hidden preludes such as fakefleet); docs/coverage.py fails a tagged block without a result

scenarios.guide: reference/sandbox-sdk (command, env, services, wait_for, url, public_url, forward)
scenarios.checks: plain image + command + services + wait_for on a named service: service(name).request with caller headers (the server 400s without them), service(name).url() and public_url(name, ttl) from a plain HTTP client (local: daemon token URL; cloud: signed URL), forward(port) as a loopback URL (cloud without spacesd: gateway proxy), portable info (id, phase, location, provider_details). hermetic: fake Fleet + MockServer through a private daemon; container: python:3.12-slim on gVisor; fleet: one live gVisor sandbox, managed pool GC'd

scenarios.guide: reference/sandbox-sdk (sidecars, Image.from_registry(secret=), image layers with local=False, warm canonical images)
scenarios.checks: hermetic: the fake Fleet admits sidecars on KubeVirt, the reserved service names main/sidecars/sc and a sidecar named main are refused, cloud layer builds fail with the typed 'not deployed yet' error before anything is created, the local core refuses layers on a VM image; container: python:3.12-slim + redis sidecar 'db' + busybox sidecar 'relay' on runc through a private daemon, the sandbox reaches db:6379 by name and the relay reaches the sandbox at main; fleet: the same group on gVisor and KubeVirt, and a processMode Run command with env serving HTTP on both runtimes

a fresh-agent session through the host `cua mcp` server only (official MCP Python SDK, no LLM): hermetic: images_list returns the published catalog with browser_tools, sandbox_create takes browser, teleport_browser_session exists; container: images_list -> sandbox_create {browser: true} on linux -> read, fill (browser_type), check and submit (browser_click) a form served in the sandbox -> tab screenshot -> sandbox_delete; fleet-env: the same on a Fleet gVisor sandbox
